hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | { read -r cmd; echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|[:space:]])git add (-A|--all)([[:space:]]|$)|(^|[;&|[:space:]])git add \.([[:space:]]|$)' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Bare git add -A/--all/. is disallowed by CLAUDE.md \u2014 stage specific files by name instead."}}'; }

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | { read -r cmd; echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git (commit|push).*(--no-verify|--no-gpg-sign)|commit\.gpgsign=false' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Skipping hooks or commit signing (--no-verify/--no-gpg-sign/commit.gpgsign=false) is disallowed unless the user explicitly asked for it."}}'; }

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | { read -r cmd; case "$cmd" in *"gh issue comment"*|*"gh pr comment"*|*"gh pr create"*|*"gh issue create"*) bad=$(echo "$cmd" | grep -oE '!\[[^]]*\]\(https?://[^) ]+\)' | grep -viE '\(https://raw\.githubusercontent\.com'); if [ -n "$bad" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"This repo is private \u2014 embed images via raw.githubusercontent.com links (verified to render), not other hosts."}}'; fi ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.tex) if command -v latexmk >/dev/null 2>&1; then latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -cd "$f" 2>&1 | tail -80; grep -E 'Overfull|Underfull' "${f%.tex}.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -20; else echo 'latexmk not found on PATH -- install a TeX distribution to enable auto-recompile' >&2; fi ;; esac; }
